"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Air Force fields the smallest and oldest force of combat aircraft in its history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Marines have only two-thirds the number of battalions they have historically needed to meet day to day operational demands.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Army is at its lowest troop levels since before World War II.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. Ambassador and American personnel were left without adequate security or backup in Benghazi.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. has returned to the hollow force days of Jimmy Carter.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Strategic forces have been neglected, especially the development and deployment of ballistic missile defenses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Ground-Based Midcourse Defense system has been delayed and underfunded.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Defense installations in Poland and the Czech Republic have been neutralized to curry favor with Russia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The number of planned interceptors in Alaska has been reduced to curry favor with Russia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The New START agreement is so weak in verification and definitions that it is virtually impossible to prove a violation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The New START agreement has allowed Russia to build up its nuclear arsenal while reducing the U.S.'s.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Moscow has repeatedly violated the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces (INF) Treaty with impunity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Moscow has covertly tested missiles banned under the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces (INF) Treaty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
